click.description: Click an element by its dom:* id. Smart cascade: href → CDP locator → JS focus (for inputs) → coordinate fallback.

double_click.description: Double-click an element by selector or coordinates.

type.description: Type text into an element, clearing any existing value first.

set_value.description: Set an input/combobox/select value directly. Routes to type, select_option, or setValueDirect depending on element type.

fill.description: Playwright fill on a form field by CSS selector — replaces any existing value atomically.

check.description: Set the checked state of a checkbox or radio by CSS selector.

select_option.description: Select a <select> option by value or visible label.

focus.description: Move keyboard focus to an element by CSS selector.

hover.description: Hover over an element (by selector or coordinates) — triggers mouseover/mousemove events.

drag.description: Mouse drag from one coordinate to another.

text_select.description: Select text by dragging between two coordinates.

scroll.description: Scroll the page by relative pixels (canonical type — routes through scroll_by).

scroll_by.description: Scroll the page by relative pixels.

scroll_to.description: Scroll an element into view by CSS selector.

key.description: Press a single key (canonical type — routes through press_key).

press_key.description: Press a single key. Accepts Playwright key names (e.g. 'Enter', 'ArrowDown', 'Control+a').

key_combo.description: Press a key combination — array of keys held simultaneously (e.g. ['Control', 'Shift', 'k']).

navigate.description: Navigate to a URL. Waits for DOM stability and dismisses any cookie-consent banner that surfaces.

wait_for.description: Wait until a selector appears in the DOM (Playwright locator wait).

wait_for_stable.description: Wait until DOM mutations quiesce (Playwright load-state + idle threshold).

screenshot.description: Capture a full-page screenshot. Returns base64 PNG data.

evaluate.description: Run JavaScript in the page context. Use cautiously — sandbox same as the page.

dismiss_cookies.description: Attempt to find and click a cookie-consent dismiss button via overlay-detector heuristics.

dismiss_cookie_consent.description: Legacy name for dismiss_cookies — kept for backward compatibility with existing planner prompts and tests.
